name: bolt.new
setup: . scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules build && npm_config_store_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-store" npm_config_cache_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-cache" npm_config_state_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-state" npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" install --frozen-lockfile
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && export HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= && ./node_modules/.bin/remix vite:build && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run
notes: Env: commands assume $RM, $SRC, $ENV are exported and scripts/env.sh is sourced (setup does this itself); run every step under `env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`. Node v24.19.0 (repo .tool-versions pins 20.15.1; engines >=18.18 and 24 works), local pnpm 10.34.7 with npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false because package.json pins packageManager pnpm@9.4.0 (lockfile v9, --frozen-lockfile works). pnpm 10 skips build scripts for esbuild/workerd; not needed (esbuild ships its platform binary via optional deps) for build or tests. test_cmd mirrors CI (.github/workflows/ci.yaml: setup-and-build runs `pnpm run build`, then `pnpm run test`): `remix vite:build` (client + server bundle into gitignored build/, ~9s, fully offline; this is the only step that compiles the LLM server code app/lib/.server/llm/* and app/routes/api.*.ts) followed by `vitest --run`. The only test file is app/lib/runtime/message-parser.spec.ts (24 tests, snapshot-based, no LLM or network use), so the unit suite does not exercise the streamText call; build + typecheck are the meaningful guards for a migration. Nothing deselected. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY forced empty; nothing calls the network. typecheck_cmd = repo `typecheck` script (`tsc`, noEmit already set in tsconfig), TypeScript 5.5.2: 0 errors. CI's eslint step is commented out, so lint is not included. Cold-cache install took 76s. 2 runs: 24 passed each (16.3s, 17.6s), identical counts; parse_counts reads {passed: 24, failed: 0, errors: 0, skipped: 0}.
